100.notes:
Old output and intermediate files are removed before processing.
Parallelization is initialized based on file or cluster configuration.
CZH input files define the processing units.
Execution stops if no valid CZH files are found.

103.notes:
DEL_LOBS scans CODXTR output for stations with >50% bad observations.
All corresponding observation files are deleted from the OBS directory.
Results are appended to the processing log file.
Each station is processed only once.
Requires DIR_OUT as input parameter.

110.notes:
TIMESTAP prepares clustered processing using MKCLUS.
Observation files are grouped into clusters for parallel GPSEST runs.

111.notes: HOI ionosphere setup is disabled if no valid input file is found (HOI$YD+0.ION).
111.input:
Phase & code Bernese observation files
"V_A"$YSS+0.CRD/STD/ERP/CLK
APR$YSS+0.OSB

112.notes:
RCLK_CHK performs an iterative quality check using RESRMS and RESCHK.
It identifies stations with problematic residuals and generates a deletion list.
Stations listed in the DEL file are removed from further processing.
Iterative reruns up to a defined maximum number of iterations.

120.notes:
FILESTAP performs station-wise zero-difference screening of GNSS observation data.
It collects PZH/CZH observation files and prepares station lists for parallel processing.

121.notes:
FILEST_P performs station-wise zero-difference data screening.
It runs GPSEST to generate residual files, applies RMS screening with RESRMS,
detects bad stations using RESCHK, and marks outliers with SATMRK.

HOI ionosphere setup is disabled if no valid input file is found (HOI$YD+0.ION).
Troposphere model can be switched to GMF via V_TRPMOD. (Default: VMF)

122.notes:
Processes GNSS clock solution files and performs epoch-wise quality control of station-based satellite clock estimates on a sampling grid (defined by V_SAMPL).
Input CLK files are merged into a sorted clock summary. Data are parsed into a hierarchical structure indexed by satellite, epoch, and station.
For each satellite epoch, the script:
enforces a minimum redundancy of 3 station observations
evaluates intra-epoch consistency via value range checks
applies simple clustering to separate coherent observation groups from outliers
flags non-dominant clusters and insufficiently supported epochs for removal.
Deletion flags are accumulated per station/satellite/epoch and written to summary and filtering output files. A consolidated satellite statistics file is generated.
Finally, station-specific edit (EDT) files are produced for downstream observation screening, and parallel processing is launched for all stations with valid residual data.
FIL$S+0???.OUT/CLK-files are deleted at the end.
